body: I saved the cloth with sticky pollen for you. The orchard spray test crew passed the late afternoon; the mare refused her feed, and afterward the bridge was blocked.
title: the late afternoon — sticky pollen
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same sticky pollen while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
I asked for clean water. The man with the bucket asked how many people were still here before he opened it.

I pointed to the room behind me. He wrote down a smaller number and said the others would be counted separately. He would not say where.

The bucket was emptied on the floor after he left. I kept the scrap he dropped because it has the number he first wrote.
title: The count in a coat pocket
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
